svg.title: States of the procurement case
svg.desc: A case moves from step 1 to step 12. Steps 1 to 9 are set by commands. Steps 10 to 12 follow from acceptance, payment and closing. Steps 2 to 8 can be cancelled, steps 4 to 7 can fail back to step 4, and the specific method jumps from step 4 to step 7.
